name: xquad_benchmark
description: xquad_benchmark is a cross-lingual extractive question answering benchmark derived from SQuAD, measuring a model's ability to locate span-based answers in contexts across multiple languages. It evaluates multilingual understanding and transfer by providing parallel QA instances in several non-English languages. Performance is typically measured with standard SQuAD metrics.
reputation: Widely used cross-lingual QA benchmark for evaluating multilingual and cross-lingual transfer of QA models.
